check_order_type: use is_hold is_move is_support is_convoy is_retreat is_disband or is_build to classify a diplomacy order string
parse_unit_info: use get_unit_type and get_unit_location to extract the unit type and location from a diplomacy order string
extract_move_destination: use get_move_or_retreat_destination to extract the destination location from a move or retreat order string
extract_support_details: use get_supported_unit_type get_supported_unit_location and get_supported_unit_destination to parse supported unit details from a support order
extract_convoy_details: use get_convoyed_unit_location and get_convoyed_unit_destination to parse convoyed unit details from a convoy order
